interfaces.name: Demucs
interfaces.description: Meta开源的高质量音源分离模型，支持多种模型变体

HDemucs.name: HDemucs
HDemucs.description: 标准 HDemucs 模型，平衡分离质量和速度

HDemucs Fine-Tuned.name: HDemucs Fine-Tuned
HDemucs Fine-Tuned.description: 微调版 HDemucs，推荐默认使用，人声分离效果最佳，但是略慢

HDemucs 6 Stems.name: HDemucs 6 Stems
HDemucs 6 Stems.description: 6 轨分离模型，输出人声/鼓/贝斯/吉他/钢琴/其他

MDX.name: MDX
MDX.description: MDX 模型，基于 Demucs 架构，适合一般分离场景

MDX Extra.name: MDX Extra
MDX Extra.description: MDX 增强版，更高的分离精度但速度较慢

interfaces.name: Spleeter
interfaces.description: Deezer开源的轻量快速音源分离，支持2/4/5轨分离，设备要求低

2stems.name: 2 Stems
2stems.description: 双轨分离：人声 + 伴奏

4stems.name: 4 Stems
4stems.description: 四轨分离：人声/鼓/贝斯/其他

5stems.name: 5 Stems
5stems.description: 五轨分离：人声/鼓/贝斯/钢琴/其他

interfaces.name: BS-Roformer
interfaces.description: 高质量、模型众多-但是吃配置。基于Band-Split RoPE Transformer的高质量音源分离，bs-roformer-infer 社区模型集合

BS-RoFormer SW.name: BS-RoFormer SW
BS-RoFormer SW.description: 默认推荐，6 轨分离（人声/鼓/贝斯/吉他/钢琴/其他），由 jarredou 训练

Vocals Revive V3e.name: Vocals Revive V3e
Vocals Revive V3e.description: 目前人声分离 SOTA，Bleedless 评分最高，适合追求纯净人声，特别慢

Vocals Revive V2.name: Vocals Revive V2
Vocals Revive V2.description: Revive V2 人声模型，平衡分离质量与速度

Vocals Revive.name: Vocals Revive
Vocals Revive.description: Revive 初版人声模型，稳定的人声分离效果

Vocals Resurrection.name: Vocals Resurrection
Vocals Resurrection.description: 专注人声修复和还原的分离模型

Vocals by Gabox.name: Vocals by Gabox
Vocals by Gabox.description: Gabox 训练的人声分离模型

Chorus Male-Female.name: Chorus Male-Female
Chorus Male-Female.description: 合唱/男女声分离模型，可分离男声和女声

Male-Female by aufr33.name: Male-Female by aufr33
Male-Female by aufr33.description: 男女声分离模型，由 aufr33 训练

Instrumental Resurrection.name: Instrumental Resurrection
Instrumental Resurrection.description: 伴奏分离模型，专注还原伴奏（人声去除）

De-Reverb.name: De-Reverb
De-Reverb.description: 去混响/去回声模型，用于消除音频中的混响效果
